Hands On Exercise 1

Author

Xi Zixun

Getting Started

Install And Launching R Packages

The Code Chunk Below Uses p_load() of pacman to check if tidyverse packages are installed in the computer. If they are, then they will be launched into R.

pacman::p_load(tidyverse)

Importing Data

exam_data <- read_csv("data/Exam_data.csv")
Rows: 322 Columns: 7
── Column specification ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Delimiter: ","
chr (4): ID, CLASS, GENDER, RACE
dbl (3): ENGLISH, MATHS, SCIENCE

ℹ Use `spec()` to retrieve the full column specification for this data.
ℹ Specify the column types or set `show_col_types = FALSE` to quiet this message.

#Essential Grammatical Elements in ggplot2:geom

Bar Chart

Dot Plot

Bin width defaults to 1/30 of the range of the data. Pick better value with
`binwidth`.
ggplot(data = exam_data,
       aes(x = MATHS)) +
  
  geom_dotplot(binwidth=2.5,
               dotsize= 0.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(NULL,
                      breaks = NULL)

Histogram

ggplot(data = exam_data,
       aes(x = MATHS)) +
  geom_histogram()
`stat_bin()` using `bins = 30`. Pick better value `binwidth`.
ggplot(data = exam_data,
       aes(x = MATHS)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20,
                 color = "black",
                 fill = "lightblue")

Modify Via aes changes

ggplot(data = exam_data,
       aes(x = MATHS,
           fill = GENDER)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20,
                color = "gray")

Density Graph

ggplot(data = exam_data,
       aes(x = MATHS)) +
  geom_density()
ggplot(data = exam_data,
       aes(x = MATHS,
           colours = GENDER)) +
  geom_density()

Box Plot

ggplot(data = exam_data,
       aes(y = MATHS,
           x = GENDER)) +
  geom_boxplot()

Box Plot With Notches (Show Median)

ggplot(data = exam_data,
       aes(y = MATHS,
           x = GENDER)) + 
  geom_boxplot(notch = TRUE)

Violin Graph (geom_violin())

ggplot(data = exam_data,
       aes(y = MATHS,
           x = GENDER)) +
  geom_violin()

Point Graph (geom_point())

ggplot(data = exam_data,
       aes(x = MATHS,
           y = ENGLISH)) +
  geom_point()

Combined Graph (Box plot + Point)

ggplot(data = exam_data,
       aes(y = MATHS,
           x = GENDER)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_point(position = "jitter",
             size = 0.5)

Working With Stats()

stat_summary() method

ggplot(data = exam_data,
       aes(y = MATHS,
           x = GENDER)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  stat_summary(geom = "point",
               fun = "mean",
               colour = "red",
               size = 4)

geom() method

ggplot(data = exam_data,
       aes(y = MATHS,
           x = GENDER)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_point(stat = "summary",
             fun = "mean",
             colour = "red",
             size = 4)

Addming Best Fit Curve for SCatter plot

ggplot(data = exam_data,
       aes(x = MATHS,
           y = ENGLISH)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_smooth(size = 0.5)
Warning: Using `size` aesthetic for lines was deprecated in ggplot2 3.4.0.
ℹ Please use `linewidth` instead.
`geom_smooth()` using method = 'loess' and formula = 'y ~ x'
ggplot(data = exam_data,
       aes(x = MATHS,
           y = ENGLISH)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_smooth(method = lm,
              linewidth = 0.5)
`geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'

Working with facet_warp()

ggplot(data = exam_data,
       aes(x = MATHS)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
  facet_wrap(~ CLASS)

facet_grid()

ggplot(data = exam_data,
       aes(x = MATHS)) + 
  geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
  facet_grid(~ CLASS)

Using Coordinate

coord_flip()

ggplot(data = exam_data,
       aes(x = RACE)) +
  geom_bar() +
  coord_flip()

fixing x and y range using coord_cartesian()

ggplot(data = exam_data,
       aes(x = MATHS,
           y = ENGLISH)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_smooth(method = lm,
              size = 0.5) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0,100),
                  ylim = c(0,100))
`geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'

Working With Theme - [Background Colour] | [Font Size] | [Grid Lines] | [Label Colours]

theme_gray()

ggplot(data = exam_data,
       aes(x = RACE)) + 
  geom_bar() +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_gray()

theme_classic()

ggplot(data = exam_data,
       aes(x = RACE)) + 
  geom_bar() +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_classic()

Theme Minimal

ggplot(data = exam_data,
       aes(x = RACE)) + 
  geom_bar() +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal()
